0022600166.text: The Timberwolves (4-3, 2-1 at home, on a one-game losing streak) are 10th in the West and 1 game back in the Northwest, while the Bucks (1-5, on a two-game losing streak) are 14th in the East and 4 games back in the Central. Minnesota will be without Anthony Edwards, who is out after knee surgery and is averaging 33.3 points and 33.7 minutes this season, and Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery and averaged 12.2 points and 30.4 minutes last season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Timberwolves swept both meetings in 2025-26, most recently winning 139-106 in Milwaukee on January 13, 2026.
